title: Hanako ve Sedir Ağacı
author: Akasya Asıltürkmen
description: Hanako and the Cedar Tree tells the story of the friendship between a little girl named Hanako and a cedar tree. Hanako lives in a fishing village and goes to town every day to help her grandmother. Along the way, a huge cedar tree greets her, listens to her stories, and becomes her best friend. One day the two friends must say goodbye, but their farewell is not an end. In this heartwarming, fairy-tale-like story, Hanako teaches children the love of nature, the power of friendship, and the courage to speak out.
